title: CNCF 日本动态：云原生正在成为 AI 基础设施与人才能力的共同底座
english: CNCF’s Japan updates highlight a growing connection between cloud native infrastructure, AI development, and technical talent. New research reports that nearly 1 million developers in Japan are part of the cloud native community, including 100,000 AI developers using cloud native technologies. Subaru’s case study reports a 60x reduction in AI container image pull times. Lima v2.2 adds Windows guest support and TPM 2.0 emulation, while CoHDI has joined the CNCF Sandbox. Kubeflow also announced cloud native innovations as it advances toward CNCF Graduation. CNCF further reports a 250% training surge in Japan after the first KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Japan.
chinese: 这组动态表明，日本的云原生生态正在同时向 AI 工程化、开发环境多样性、基础设施架构和人才培养延伸。对于运维开发团队，Subaru 的案例尤其说明，容器镜像分发效率会直接影响 AI 工作流的交付速度。Lima 对 Windows 虚拟机与 TPM 2.0 模拟的支持，则扩展了统一开发工作流可覆盖的系统范围。Kubeflow、CoHDI 与 CNCF 社区人才增长共同反映出：Kubernetes 周边能力正成为 AI 平台建设的重要组成部分。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与 AIOps 而言，AI 平台的瓶颈不仅在模型，也在镜像拉取、工作流自动化、运行环境和基础设施资源组织。资深运维开发应关注 Kubernetes 上的 ML 工作负载、镜像供应链性能、跨系统开发环境及可组合基础设施。对职业发展而言，日本云原生社区规模、AI 开发者采用情况和培训增长都表明，云原生技能与 AI 工程能力的交叉价值正在上升。
interview_expression: I see cloud native infrastructure as a core enabler for production AI, not only as a deployment layer. I would focus on measurable operational constraints such as image distribution, workflow automation, and the reliability of Kubernetes-based ML platforms.

vocabulary.meaning: 云原生；围绕容器、Kubernetes 等技术构建和运行应用的方法与生态。
vocabulary.example: Cloud native technologies are increasingly used to support AI development.

vocabulary.meaning: 容器镜像拉取时间；运行工作负载前从镜像仓库获取镜像所需的时间。
vocabulary.example: Reducing container image pull time can accelerate AI workflow delivery.

vocabulary.meaning: CNCF 沙箱；CNCF 用于支持早期云原生项目发展的项目阶段。
vocabulary.example: CoHDI has been accepted as a CNCF Sandbox project.
